_about: Worked examples from the CUVET year-5 epidemiology course (2026 decks), as transcribed into the VetMock question bank src/data/questions-y5-epidemiology-2026-c.js. Each entry names the bank item id and the deck title stored in that item's `source` field. Values are the course's own answers; the formulas are the ones the item explanation writes out. Course mode must reproduce `courseAnswer` exactly and name the formula; the other fields are the unrounded values of that formula. Copied by the architect on 2026-09-27 from the bank at worktree commit abb9b765. Owner after M1 scaffold: epi role.

items.deck: Measurement of disease frequency- measurement of association- diagnostic test

items.formula: p1 = p0 OR / (1 + p0 (OR - 1)); n = (z_a/2 + z_b)^2 pbar (1 - pbar) (r + 1) / (r (p1 - p0)^2), rounded up (course); Fleiss without and with continuity correction are the two alternatives shown
items.note: methods.md 2.6: the course number matches the pooled-variance form; epiR::epi.sscc (Dupont) not yet run

items.formula: n = (z_a/2 + z_b)^2 / d^2, rounded up (normal approximation)
items.note: t-based methods (pwr::pwr.t.test) give more; show as the alternative with R's number from rparity

items.formula: n = z^2 SD^2 / d^2, rounded up; the course writes z = 1.96
course: n = n0 / (1 + (n0 - 1) / N); epiR epi.sssimpleestb: n / (1 + n / N)
DEFF = 1 + (m - 1) rho; n x DEFF rounded up
